films.title: Mossbook
films.about: Launch film for an invented plant journal app, made from its README and two source files.
films.alt: A monstera grows in a round photo that becomes the app's plant screen
films.prompt: /video Make the launch film for this project: one 9:16 cut for Reels and TikTok and one 16:9 cut for the site. I am away, so do not stop to ask; make it beautiful.
films.plan_note: One circle carries the film: a weekly plant photo becomes the phone's Plant screen, opens onto a windowsill, dives into a sick leaf, and pulls back to a room map as the sun moves through the seasons.

films.title: quillstack
films.about: Launch film for an invented command line tool that writes release notes from git commits, made from its README and source.
films.alt: Commit messages fly past in a tunnel of light and land as a clean changelog
films.prompt: /video Make the launch film for this project: one 9:16 cut for Reels and TikTok and one 16:9 cut for the site. I am away, so do not stop to ask; make it beautiful.
films.plan_note: The camera flies through a storm of commit messages; they sort themselves into Added, Fixed and Changed and pour into a clean changelog card, which stacks into versions and becomes the quill logo.
